baseline_same_taxon_reference.baseline_provenance_note: The baseline Moreyra sample is cultivated/garden provenance; the augmentation is the natural Ulleung genome sample.

candidates.placement_expectation: The natural Ulleung genome-derived Cirsium nipponicum tip should recover the neighbourhood of the existing baseline Cirsium nipponicum taxon representation without changing the 294-tip shared backbone. A different placement is biologically interesting and routes to manual review rather than threshold relaxation.

locus_rule: For each baseline mapping mode, baseline294 and cnipg_295 use the exact intersection of the accepted baseline loci for that mode and the frozen 180-locus genome-derived pack.
automatic_promotion_requires: retain at least 100 paired loci separately against the accepted BWA and BLASTx baseline locus sets
run baseline294 and cnipg_295 on the identical paired locus set within each baseline mapping mode
shared-294-tip concatenated unrooted RF distance equals zero in both baseline mapping modes
an existing baseline Cirsium nipponicum tip is among the nearest baseline neighbours of AUG_ULLEUNG_CNIP2024 in both baseline mapping modes
shared source-label ASTRAL species backbone unrooted RF distance equals zero in both baseline mapping modes
do not alter locus thresholds, homology thresholds or topology gates post hoc to admit the genome-derived tip
manual_review_triggers: paired locus count below 100 in either baseline mapping mode
non-zero shared-294-tip RF in either baseline mapping mode
same-taxon baseline tip absent from the nearest-neighbour set in either baseline mapping mode
non-zero shared-species ASTRAL RF in either baseline mapping mode
combined_ceiling_note: 294 baseline + EA01 + EA02 + CNIPG. This is a candidate sample-level ceiling, not an accepted combined 297-tip tree. A final combined tree still requires an explicit common paired-locus contract across all admitted candidates.
